title: Referral reward
description: Full-viewport referral screen composing the kpi-card block: what a member's referrals have earned them — friends invited, friends joined, rewards earned — one KPI card each with its change and its trend, with the block's loading, error and empty states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm, @md and @lg contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm; the title grows and the footer lines up at @md; the cards sit side by side at @lg.
